associations.rationale: The formal type directly states or defines the item: A category whose subobject orders are finite-dimensional.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The subobjects of any object form a finite-dimensional order.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Each object's subobject order is finite-dimensional.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The opaque auxiliary type is finite.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Every simple object is isomorphic to an object indexed by the auxiliary type.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The object of the category associated to an auxiliary index.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The object associated to an auxiliary index is simple.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The category has an abelian category structure.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The category has enough projectives.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: An auxiliary type associated to the category.
